evidence: Changes private broadcast connection lifecycle and node finalization in src/net_processing.cpp and src/private_broadcast.cpp under P2P label.
rationale: Prevents an origin deanonymization leak where returning transactions early could cancel remaining connections. The PR description notes it addresses 'theoretical timing attacks' where an adversary returning a transaction quickly could correlate broadcasters, directly impacting the privacy of transaction origin which P2P treats as a top priority.
